name: Montréal-Trudeau International Airport

curfew.v: Open 24 hours for propeller aircraft and jets under 45,000 kg. Jets over 45,000 kg: take-offs only 07:00-midnight and landings only 07:00-01:00 local; ADM may grant exemptions only for medical emergencies, delays beyond the carrier's control, bad weather and some scheduled flights. Window shown is for jets over 45,000 kg (e.g. large-cabin jets); smaller jets have no night limit
curfew.quote: YUL Montréal-Trudeau est ouvert 24 heures par jour pour les avions à hélices et les jets de moins de 45 000 kilogrammes. ... les heures normales d’exploitation sont de 7h00 à minuit pour les décollages ... de 7h00 à 1h00 pour les atterrissages.

hours.v: Airport open 24 hours for propeller aircraft and jets under 45,000 kg MTOW
hours.quote: YUL Montréal-Trudeau est ouvert 24 heures par jour pour les avions à hélices et les jets de moins de 45 000 kilogrammes.

permits.v: Canadian Transportation Agency: non-scheduled international services to and from Canada are licensed by the Agency (exemptions to the licence duty exist; that notice was not read). For a licensed airline with aircraft under 15,900 kg MCTOW, no charter permit, notices or reports, except a foreign licensee flying between Canada and a country other than its home country, which must apply for a charter permit. At 15,900 kg or more the rule depends on route and passengers or goods; check the CTA guide. Guide page last modified 14 Dec 2020
permits.quote: you do not have to apply for a charter permit or send us any notices or reports.
